name: Bustfree!
author: Adam Smith (adamsmasher); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Bustfree!, a brick-busting arcade game for the Game Boy by Adam Smith (2021), written in assembly live on stream: bounce the ball with your paddle and clear every brick. MIT license (github.com/adamsmasher/bustfree).

descriptions.en: Bustfree!, a brick-busting arcade game for the Game Boy by Adam Smith (2021), written in assembly live on stream: bounce the ball with your paddle and clear every brick. MIT license (github.com/adamsmasher/bustfree).
descriptions.it: Bustfree!, un gioco arcade da spaccamattoni per Game Boy di Adam Smith (2021), scritto in assembly in diretta streaming: fai rimbalzare la pallina con la racchetta e distruggi tutti i mattoncini. Licenza MIT (github.com/adamsmasher/bustfree).
